versions.changelog:
## Removed
- Remove retired ideogram-v3-reframe from the selectable Ideogram V3 skill variants.
  Migration: Do not submit new Reframe tasks; new requests return HTTP 410. Query existing task IDs through the task-status API. Other Ideogram V3 variants remain available; no automatic model replacement is provided.

## Changed
- Generate the ideogram-v3 skill from the shared RunAPI recipe with contract-discovered request rules and task behavior, direct local media inputs, complete result verification, and bounded recovery.

## Changed
- Complete marketplace distribution for the RunAPI Ideogram V3 skill.
